entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA1873 False positive for guarded non-extension logger calls #50893
  • Test failing in CI: Microsoft.DotNet.Tests.PackagedCommandTests.CanInvokeToolWhosePackageNameIsDifferentFromDllName #50892
  • [WebToolsE2E] Cannot exceed the range of more than 10 when changing the /weatherforecast in Program.cs #50884
  • Investigate feasibility of using cache-related ideas from RunCommand in dotnet test for MTP #50883
  • [NETSDKE2E][MAC] Unable to build project created with .NET 10 RC2. #50881
    10.0.1xx

Closed

  • RunReadyToRunCompiler fails when nuget config value 'globalPackagesFolder' contains @ (e.g. package path contains @) #50790
  • The "Uninstall Successfully Completed" status message is not announced by the screen reader when uninstalling the .NET 9.0 SDK. : A11y_.NET SDK and CLI_Uninstall the SDK_Status Messages #50653
  • The link present on the installation window are not accessible with any keyboard keys: A11y_.NET SDK and CLI_Uninstall the SDK_Keyboard. #50658
  • Gather feature-level telemetry about `dotnet run` #50792
  • [NETSDKE2E]With .NET 10 RC2, hostfxr probing messages are displayed in terminal output when running some dotnet command. #50632
  • `dotnet list reference` command is not working in .NET 10 RC1. Returns Invalid project. The project file could not be loaded. Could not find a part of the path. #50830
    10.0.1xx
  • dotnet pack malfesience involving documentation #50880
  • [New MSBuild Task] Add a Task for evaluating the 'best' RID #50611
  • Failed to build the project with error "An error occurred trying to start process" after installing the 10.0 RC2 SDK on Mac OS #50882
  • [NETSDKE2E][Loc][Regression]With NET 10 preview4 SDK installed in loc OS, some strings are not localized in output of "dotnet build --help". #48765
  • [NETSDKE2E][Loc][Regression]With NET 10 preview4 SDK installed in loc OS, some strings are not localized when creating project in CLI. #48779
  • [New MSBuild Task] Allow filtering a set of Items by matching on compatible RuntimeIdentifier #50614
